designSummary: Narrative synthesis by strategy type with a structured summary table, an effect direction plot and GRADE certainty per outcome; meta-analysis only where comparable controlled studies allow it.
sampleSize: No sample size applies to a review. The expected yield is about 1,500 records and 30 to 40 included studies, based on the 2021 review's 26 studies plus later work. A random-effects meta-analysis is planned only when at least three controlled studies of the same strategy report the same outcome in comparable units; otherwise effects are reported study by study with their direction and size.
primaryAnalysis: For each strategy type, absolute change in the proportion of patients with at least one low-value test (or tests per patient) is tabulated with design, follow-up and risk of bias, and summarised in an effect direction plot; certainty is rated per strategy and outcome.
secondaryAnalysis: Durability at 12 months or later; single versus combined strategies described side by side; same-day cancellations and 30-day complications tabulated wherever reported, with the number of studies that did not report them.
missingData: Outcomes not reported are recorded as not reported, never assumed unchanged; study authors are not contacted within the ten-week window, which is stated as a limitation.
multiplicity: No hypothesis testing across strategies; comparisons between strategies are descriptive and labelled as indirect.
software: Reference manager for screening, a shared spreadsheet for extraction, and R for any meta-analysis and the effect direction plot.
overfittingGuards: No ranking of strategies from indirect comparisons presented as a finding
summary: Narrative synthesis by strategy with an effect direction plot; meta-analysis only with at least three comparable controlled studies.
